prechange_probe.mutation: attributes.postconditions true to false without changing the released file

impact.observed: Persisted execution evidence can be changed after emission while all current telemetry checks and the completed evaluation disposition remain green.
impact.bounded_risk: The weakness affects evidence reliability and post-hoc audit truth in the synthetic release. It does not alter executor enforcement or connect to real infrastructure.
impact.selected_improvement: Add deterministic sequence and SHA-256 continuity to each JSONL event, fail closed before appending to a corrupt prefix, and bind completed evaluations to exact event count and final event digest.
impact.non_claim: An unkeyed chain cannot authenticate the writer or resist a hostile actor that can recompute the complete chain and its anchor.
